question: Can a tokenless native-style structural learner acquire a reusable causal-parent prior from past true interventions, infer previously unseen essential 3-parent effects with only 12 new-world probes, repair context/version-specific contradictory knowledge without destroying old causal models, and outperform equal-data fully fitted conventional/strong Bayesian controls?
hypothesis: Acquired historical causal associations may guide active query selection and improve new-law inference and versioned retention versus an identical active posterior without learned structural priors. This is falsifiable: the strong same-experience Bayesian learner is expected to tie if the numerical technique merely replicates Bayesian counting, in which case scientific superiority NO-GO.
predecessor_evidence: Issue #1088 conditional native Yggdrasil integration requires verified benefit over strong controls; not an automatic main merge
FKP03 draft PR #1093: 100% active DEV held accuracy but ties preprogrammed 3-input grammar and strong known-family exact symbolic; foundation necessity unproven
FKP04 draft PR #1095: 1,048,576 exact observed transitions, 100% active DEV but ties exact conventional table, development positive threshold NO-GO; no destructive interference verified
Main native yggdrasil/public_causal_cells.py has 16 addresses/128 learned bytes and remains unchanged; contributor source is not native integration

inputs.name: Original fully synthetic FKP05-SRC-V1 generator protocol, 8-bit interventions (public development only)
inputs.source: SHA256 UTF-8 canonical: FKP05-SRC-V1|8-input-bits|128-prior-worlds|32-foundation-actions|24-development-worlds|12-new-world-actions|64-pool|128-held|unfamiliar-essential-3-parent-truth-tables|source-private-parent-bias|8-overwrite-versions|protected-primary=1600..1663|dev=600..623|foundation=20000..20127|interference=640..647 . Code identity and exact source/controlled classifier committed and pinned before evaluation; no paid/external data, protected evaluation key absent

seeds.foundation: 20000..20127 exactly 128 disjoint historical 2-parent worlds, 32 source interventions/world
seeds.development: 600..623 exactly 24 original DEV worlds, each unknown essential 3-parent truth-table law
seeds.interference: 640..647 exactly 8 contradictory new revisions of contexts 600..607, with new source-private essential 3-parent laws
seeds.primary: 1600..1663; protected evaluator-first-use NEVER instantiate in research CI/local
seeds.negative: 2600..2615; protected outside-three-parent family NEVER instantiate in research CI/local

frozen_design.split: 8 binary input concepts => 256 possible states. Source public candidate pool is 64 unique 8-bit actions; held scorer uses 128 distinct disjoint states per DEV world. Foundation source uses genuinely observed 32 random actions per world on AND/OR/XOR/NAND with unknown parent pair, with source-private bias selecting pair (0,1) in 75% of historical worlds and otherwise uniform. New unknown laws use arbitrary 8-bit truth tables that depend on each of 3 parents (essential), including functions not observed in historical 2-parent foundation; source privately selects triple including historical frequent pair (0,1) in 75% of worlds and otherwise uniformly random. Parent triples and true tables never supplied to learner or controls. Source DEV key published, protected source uses separately held owner HMAC key and is not instantiated.
frozen_design.ordering: Foundation actions sorted from deterministic public source-only seeded 32/256 independent state inputs. Per new world, 64 public candidate actions and 128 held states fixed from independent public RNG streams before first observed consequence; policies may use 12 distinct genuine observed interventions. Evaluate predictions ONLY after all arms completed action sequences, no hidden rule/source attributes in model. DEV 24 worlds then 8 version-overwrite worlds with original context IDs 600..607 and revision 2; checkpoint old predictions BEFORE new outcome revision learning; test both revisions after updates and cold restore.
frozen_design.data_budget: 128 historical worlds ×32 real intervention outcomes =4096 foundation examples to EVERY arm, plus 12 paid interventions per arm per DEV/new revision world. All arms see same action pool but can choose different actions; action feedback differs by policy and must be counted. Fully trained independent conventional baselines may fit to same actual action transcripts and historical observations; no extra source queries. 128 held actions per world are evaluation only.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Python stdlib implementation for foundation source/matched Bayesian and numerical native-style candidate; optional scikit-learn DecisionTreeClassifier trained to full deterministic fit on exact per-world transcript (no paid calls), must not claim qualification if library unavailable. At most 12 genuine actions/world/arm, 64 candidate actions per step; 56 possible parent triples ×218 essential Boolean functions =12208 hypotheses/effect; 24 original worlds and 8 interference worlds. Exact same 12-query budget; fixed posterior prior counts, alpha=1, bias 75% given source but never private target IDs. Report number evaluated candidate hypotheses, initialization/fit/inference total wall+CPU time, serialized model bytes, cost including historical source/learning and full cold retention. Resource claims unqualified absent matched whole-process baselines.
frozen_design.capacity: At most 8 input concepts, 1 binary effect, full generic 3-input Boolean function library 256 values (218 essential), 56 triples, at most 12208 posterior hypotheses, per-context/version knowledge histories 12 observations and 128 sealed held predictions, 32 original worlds+revisions max. Store only provenance-checked public observed evidence and numerical posterior, not original private source rule IDs.
frozen_design.evaluator: DEV held prediction accuracy over 24 original worlds x128 disjoint held actions, plus 8 contradictory revision worlds x128, per-world exact state accuracy. Old revision held prediction digest equality after contradictory update, cold bit-exact restore, anti-poison rejection of corrupt snapshot, abstention on unknown context. Compare active structural learned prior vs active uniform-prior exact solver, inactive randomized action policy with learned prior, competent fully trained conventional decision tree, strong exact Bayesian same-experience prior/control. World-cluster paired bootstrap 10000 with RNG seed9090, report 95% CI. Distinguish conditional operator invention from merely selecting supplied source family.
frozen_design.privacy: Development seed/key intentionally public and NOT an independent blinded scientific result. Primary/negative worlds require external private owner key, never pass source object, seed/private rule or private key to learner. No protected calls on GitHub or current local runtime.
frozen_design.source_identifiability_gate: Before protected first-use, DEV exact matched Bayesian reference with 12 actions must not already saturate >0.995 accuracy for both context groups, and full 64 public actions must yield at least +0.03 accuracy improvement. If saturated, stop SOURCE_NO_HEADROOM. Do not recast code-only DEV as independent scientific qualification.

controls: A: learned historical parent-pair prior + posterior native-style direct numerical hypothesis memory + entropy-guided next intervention, with context/version checkpoint

B: same exact hypothesis grammar and active query selection but historical pair prior replaced with uniform (no knowledge transfer); both still receive all historical episodes, with sham prior writes to match storage/compute
C: same historical pair prior, exact posterior inference, but frozen source-public random intervention order (passive selection)

D: strong exact Bayesian solver given same 4096 foundation experiences and 12 interventions, allowed to learn same historical pair frequencies and use same active entropy query scoring; a tie is a scientific NO-GO for unique advantage

E: fully trained conventional decision tree / fitting reference, max depth 8, no pruning, trained to 100% on exactly the 12 new-world source actions; full input size/params, fit convergence and end-to-end cost disclosed; if not fully trained, cannot claim strongest qualification
F: context-unscoped single latest-rule overwriting memory, a deliberate interference negative, same 12 outcomes per revision; test old versions lost, do not count as strongest conventional
G: preloaded exact source-parent distribution and finite hypothesis grammar, same 12 feedback budget; stronger-information ceiling, not same-data causal-invention proof
H: no-foundation prior majority/zero and static lookup baseline with identical new-world action consequences
metrics: Original DEV 24-world 128-held predictions/world: A vs uniform B paired world accuracy, report delta & CI; A must exceed B by >=0.05 and positive 95% CI lower bound.
Active A vs passive C >=0.05 absolute held accuracy, positive CI lower bound, and both actual 3-parent truth-table function subgroups nonregressing.
Across 8 context revisions, exact old-revision retained predictions 100%, revised-context predictions nonregressing, cold restored scores and fixed checkpoint SHA; corrupt snapshots rejected.

Must beat or equal within 0.005 all sufficiently trained same-information conventional Bayesian and tree controls; if tie to fully fitted strongest Bayesian, label dev mechanism positive at most, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native integration.
Source identifiability independent ceiling and 64-action gap, original per-world action/query receipts, memory bytes, full process CPU wall, reason for any irreducible ambiguity or selection ties.

Family unknown to every learner; original source structure separate from explicit source-supplied private rule ID; out-of-family evaluations must be tested independently on untouched source for science.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_MECHANISM_CANDIDATE_ONLY if A improves over B and C by >=0.05 on 24 public DEV worlds with both positive paired 95% bootstrap lower bounds, 100% old context retention after 8 contradictions, no checkpoint corruption acceptance, and valid source/cost receipts. Even passing is NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS until independent outside-family source, fully qualified strongest baseline, original protected owner science and real native model gate.
classification_rules.mixed: A may improve over B/C but ties or loses to fully trained equal-information Bayesian or conventional controls; label MIXED_DEV_NO_NATIVE_INTEGRATION. 100% retention alone is not learning superiority.
classification_rules.negative: Any of A vs B/C below thresholds, or complete Bayesian/equal-information conventional tie without measured whole-process efficiency/retention advantage, or retention failure: DEV_NO_GO; preserve negatives without post-outcome tweaking.
classification_rules.invalid: Hidden source law, actual parent ID or source private key leaked into fitting, world revision key not frozen, oracle outcomes used beyond 12 actions, held labels used in fit, missing strong comparator, source/algorithm fingerprints not frozen before run, insufficient full regression for engineering claims, misleading local-vs-independent source test: INVALID/UNVERIFIED as applicable.

prohibited_after_primary_run: no post-hoc tuning on revealed original DEV held outcomes
no increasing capacity/actions/memory/compute after original run
no main or production promotion without separate owner authority
preregistration_note: Freeze protocol alone before any original source implementation and DEV held outcomes. Protected main science remains unopened and no native Yggdrasil model is altered. This is independent successor to FKP04 NO-GO, not replay/tuning its consumed DEV.
